scope: Materials Project MoS2 polymorph demo queue

minimum_evidence: one recorded structural or Materials Project dimensionality indication
dimensionality_review.confirmed_2d_rule: Use only when material-ID-specific evidence supports a layered/two-dimensional structure; formula-level evidence is insufficient.
dimensionality_review.uncertain_rule: Use when evidence conflicts, is formula-level only, or cannot distinguish a bulk polymorph from a layered record.
dimensionality_review.non_2d_rule: Use when material-ID-specific structure evidence supports a three-dimensional/non-layered record.

calculation_method_review.pass_rule: The Band Gap and stability properties used by the queue must have traceable method metadata compatible with the frozen method cohort.
calculation_method_review.pending_rule: Use when the web page displays a method but API origins/thermo linkage has not been verified.
calculation_method_review.fail_rule: Use when required properties belong to an incompatible method cohort or provenance cannot be reconciled.

promotion_authority: automatic rule evaluation after recorded human review; neither an LLM nor formula-level metadata may self-approve a record
audit_retention: retain previous values, reviewer, timestamp, evidence and reasons in the change log
